acl_entries.description: List of ACL entries defining admin permissions in kadmind. Each entry specifies a principal, its permissions, and optionally a target principal and/or instance.

comment.description: Optional comment line (starts with #). If non-empty, rendered as a standalone comment line.

principal.description: Kerberos principal granted permission (e.g., admin/admin@EXAMPLE.COM). Required.

permissions.description: Space-separated list of permissions (e.g., 'a' for all, 'i' for insert, 'l' for list, 's' for set password). Common: 'a', 'i', 'l', 'c', 's'.

target_principal.description: Optional target principal for scoped permissions (e.g., 'kadmin/changepw'). If omitted, permission applies globally to the principal's scope.

instance.description: Optional instance name (e.g., 'admin'). Usually omitted; used when a non-default instance is specified in the principal.
